summary: 20+ years of international technology leadership experience as CTO of IBM Canada Consulting, Global CIO of Intact/RSA Insurance & Financial Corporation and Global Head of IT & Enterprise Architecture at Allianz Group.

positions.title: Senior Technology Executive (SVP) and Head of Global Enterprise & IT Architecture at Allianz Group
positions.description:
Reporting to the Global Allianz Group CTO and leading a team of 30 Executives and Senior Executives.

Translating the global business strategy of harmonization, rapid productivity, smart growth, customer centricity, and resilience into global technology initiatives.

Defining and executing Allianz’s global IT strategy across 80+ countries and operating entities, together with regional CIOs and Chief Architects, and in close collaboration with Allianz Technology for delivery. 

Within a global Allianz IT budget of €5B+, driving the standardization, harmonization, and rollout of global platforms and technologies — including cloud adoption (e.g., AWS/Azure), data and analytics platforms, cybersecurity frameworks, and standardized architectures — across all business and technology domains to unlock global scale, reuse, faster delivery, productivity gains, cost savings, and resilience across all lines of business worldwide.


Selected Results:

Led multiple global platform transformations including the rollout of a cloud-native Core Insurance Suite (BMP) and a modern Data & Analytics Platform (ADP) across Europe, APAC, and the UK — accelerating product time-to-market, enabling modular evolution, and unlocking AI/ML use cases, with expansion plans covering 20+ additional countries.

Consolidated fragmented enterprise systems by migrating up to 15 regional SAP instances into a central SAP RISE cloud environment and establishing a global finance data pool leveraging ADP to standardize reporting, reduce cost, and improve operational resilience.

Modernized core workplace and customer engagement technology by deploying a cloud-based global Contact Center solution and harmonizing end-user computing to standardized device and virtual client models — improving agent efficiency, reducing complexity, and increasing support scalability across 80+ countries.

positions.title: Head of Growth Initiatives (M&A) & Quality Assurance at Allianz Group Technology
Chief Information Officer (CIO) & SVP - North America and Global Chief Architect
positions.description:
Reporting to the Global COO. Leading a team of 3500+ technology experts in North America on a yearly IT budget of $500M+, and working in close collaboration with our respective regional IT teams in the US, UK, Ireland, Middle-East. Responsible for our Global Group Technology Strategy and our Global Group Enterprise & Solution Architecture, as well as for all Software Engineering, IT Infrastructure, Cloud, IT Services and Security across North America.


Results:

Translating the Global Business Strategy of Commercial Lines and Personal Lines outperformance in underwriting, reduction of legacy systems, harmonization of Specialty Lines across North America, Data and ML driven pricing, best Claims experience and best Digital Self Service into IT organizational changes and large-scale transformation initiatives. 

Growing the team from 3000 to over 3500 international technology experts by successfully integrating the acquisitions of OneBeacon (US), The Guarantee (US and Canada) and RSA (Canada, UK, Ireland, Sweden, Middle-East, etc.). 

Strengthening the global team by hiring regional CIOs for the US and the UK, as well as three VPs for Enterprise Architecture, Cloud Transformation and Commercial Platform Engineering. 

Growing two branches of the IT organization: Digital Lab and Data Lab. Covering behavioral science, design, marketing and software engineering as well as bringing machine learning models for pricing, fraud detection and churn prevention to production across all provinces.

Leading in-house development of two new insurance platforms for Commercial Lines and Personal Lines. Achieving proven efficiency gains in quoting, turnaround time of agents and speed to market of new insurance products.  

Leading Salesforce, Guidewire, KPMG and Deloitte partnerships to develop new Claims and Broker portals across Canada. Significantly improved user experience (NPS), faster turn-around times in claims adjusting and increased automation.

positions.title: CTO & Chief Architect for Application Innovation & Digital/Web/Mobile at IBM Consulting, Canada
positions.description:
Reporting to the Head of IBM Canada Global Business Services (GBS) (now Consulting) - Application Innovation, Digital & interactive eXperience (iX). 

Leading all technical Pre-Sales activities in collaboration with Partners and Associate Partners.

Leading Post-Sales, a team of 50+ Executive and Senior Enterprise, Solution and Application architects on 25+ projects from east coast to west coast of Canada as well as into the US.

Successfully delivering of a wide range of innovative Digital, Mobile, Web, IoT, Digital, Blockchain, Cloud, SOA, Microservices & APIs Solutions for large international enterprise clients such as Suncor Energy, Westjet, Interac Canada, National Bank of Canada, Bank of Montreal, ExxonMobil and Husky Energy across Travel & Transportation, Banking (Retail and Mobile Payments), Insurance, Retail and Energy industries. 

Application Innovation Services (AIS), IBM Interactive Experience (iX), Mobile & Digital, Web, Internet of Things and Enterprise B2B, B2C, B2E Solution engagements.

positions.title: Technology Innovation, Strategy & Operational Managment, Startup Advisor & Coach and Agile Lead
positions.company: Center for Digital Technology and Management (CDTM)
positions.description:
Member of the Management Team and responsible for business development, R&D projects, education program management as well as for the IT infrastructure administration, maintenance and transformation team. 

As Technology Expert/Advisor and Lead Solution Architect, led several highly successful Technology Innovation R&D cooperations with industry partners Deutsche Telekom and Telefonica O2 Germany. Secured multi-year extension for Deutsche Telekom cooperation. 

Led several Future Trend Scenario and agile Product Development/Prototyping projects with start-up, medium and large industry partners such as Aloqa, Siemens, BMW, NTT Docomo and the German Federal Ministry of Economics and Technology. 

As Technical Advisor and Coach, supported over a dozen early stage tech startups in the Mobile, Web and IoT space.

Managed the International Office for bi-annually and bi-directional student/researcher exchange with international partners UC Berkeley, Columbia University, Georgia Institute of Technology, Waseda Tokyo, HEC Montreal and Telecom ParisTech.
